claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.crit_immunity_against_wearer
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing passive magic-item family fits, but the surface has no honest way to encode a wearer-side replacement that downgrades incoming critical hits to normal hits. `modify_crit_range` only models changing the threshold on attack rolls, which is the wrong direction and would produce a misleading trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_adamantine_armor.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
